name: Alvin Baldus
summary: Alvin James "Al" Baldus (April 27, 1926 – February 2, 2017) was an American businessman, lobbyist, and Democratic politician from Dunn County, Wisconsin.  He served three terms in the U.S. House of Representatives, representing Wisconsin's 3rd congressional district from 1975 to 1981.  He also served 16 years in the Wisconsin State Assembly (1967–1975 & 1989–1997).
